EFI SYSTEM — Fuel System

14. REMOVE DELIVERY PIPE
(a) Remove the three bolts, and then remove the delivery pipe with the injectors.
NOTICE: Be careful not to drop the injectors.
(b) Remove the six insulators and three spacers from the cylinder head.

15. REMOVE INJECTORS
(a) Pull out the injectors from the delivery pipe.
(b) Remove the O-ring from the injector.
